campaign.title: M2 hard-TOP t=1 complete residual signed-divisor transport gate

resource_policy.literature_policy: Derive the exact residual Abel, transport, unmatched-mass, profile-jump, outer-phase, and power ledgers first. Use a primary fixed-modulus prime-distribution source only if a semiprime or multiprime capacity statement becomes promotion-relevant; raw counts remain diagnostic and never certify physical oscillatory mass.

frozen_target.question: Can the complete literal residual t=1 scalar after subtracting exactly the Round-163 close-opposite-prime XOR incidence sector be bounded by L^(3/2)X^epsilon through an exact cumulative signed-divisor or monotone-transport identity, possibly retaining cross-N square-root phase cancellation; or do unmatched sign mass, transport distance, hard amplitude jumps, diagnostic semiprime capacity, rank-one product geometry, or restored powers repay the full L^(1/2-o(1)) gain?
frozen_target.reference_formula: S_(L,1)^rem=sum_(N asymp L^2)mu^2(N)(L^2/N)^(3/4)e(Jsqrt(N)) sum_(d|N,d odd)chi4(d)rho_N(d)A_N(d), where rho_N is one if no pair was selected and otherwise retains exactly neither/both selected-prime incidences. A_N is the literal zero-extended eta_L Phi W amplitude with every half-open shell, cone, floor, star, endpoint, and parity convention. The target is |S_(L,1)^rem|<<_epsilon L^(3/2)X^epsilon.
quantities: For each N, the accepted selector depends on N,L,kappa and not on the divisor allocation; it may be absent.
The residual contains every no-pair product and every neither-selected-prime or both-selected-prime incidence, with the accepted XOR sector subtracted exactly once.
For ordered residual odd divisors d_i, sigma_i=chi4(d_i), and C_j=sum_(i<=j)sigma_i, exact Abel gives sum_i sigma_i A_i=C_r A_r+sum_(j<r)C_j(A_j-A_(j+1)).
Equal-mass monotone transport, unequal sign mass, hard jump terms, and zero-extension cemetery terms are distinct.
The outer phase e(Jsqrt(N)) is constant within one N but must remain available across N if positive transport exceeds target.
Positive capacity may be L^(2+o(1)); the target requires L^(1/2-o(1)) cancellation after every literal cost.
No t=1 result transfers automatically to other few-point channels, hard TOP, smooth M2 packets, M9-M2, M9, the bridge, or a global exponent.

completion_criteria: Define the residual indicator exactly for no-pair and selected-pair products and prove that the accepted XOR incidence sector is removed once and only once.
Derive the ordered-divisor Abel and cumulative Stieltjes identities for odd and even N with the literal zero extension and endpoint conventions.
Classify equal character mass, unmatched sign mass, monotone transport, cemetery atoms, and every hard amplitude jump without assuming a perfect matching.
Restore the total logarithmic displacement, cumulative discrepancy, incidence multiplicity, and L-H-J-X power ledger.
If semiprime or multiprime capacity is used, prove the exact residual and profile placement, audit any primary prime-distribution input, and quarantine raw counts from physical lower-mass claims.

If within-N positive transport is too large, retain e(Jsqrt(N)) and derive the smallest exact cross-N coefficient norm, bilinear form, or oscillatory theorem needed; compare it with the accepted rank-one product-collar obstruction.
Prove the residual target, an owner-complete quantitatively defined residual sector, or the smallest rigorous residual transport no-go.
Close under exactly one label: hard_top_t1_residual_target, strict_t1_residual_transport_sector, or hard_top_t1_residual_transport_no_go.

tasks.target: Attack the complete literal residual, not another sparse sector. Derive the exact cumulative-discrepancy and monotone-transport identities, attempt the full target, and if positive transport fails retain the outer square-root phase and isolate or prove the smallest cross-N signed theorem that could recover the missing half-power.

The exact residual Abel, transport, unmatched, profile-jump, outer-phase, and power ledgers.
A target theorem, owner-complete quantitative sector, or smallest rigorously scoped transport and cross-N frontier.
Write only the assigned report and make no graph or shared-state edit.

Verify monotone transport normalization, unequal sign mass, cemetery atoms, hard jumps, profiles, incidence multiplicity, and every L-H-J-X power.
Audit semiprime and multiprime constructions and every source hypothesis; distinguish coefficient-uniform capacity from literal weighted physical mass.
